general_information.Description: The course provides foundational knowledge and hands-on experience in connecting, programming, and controlling peripheral devices in modern embedded and IoT systems. Students will explore hardware architecture, communication standards, driver programming techniques, signal processing, and methods for integrating sensors, actuators, and communication modules with microcontrollers or processors. The course focuses on the interaction between hardware, firmware, and peripheral devices, aiming to equip students with the ability to build practical applications such as mini robots, automated control systems, smart IoT devices, and industrial embedded systems.

description: The course provides foundational knowledge and hands-on experience in connecting, programming, and controlling peripheral devices in modern embedded and IoT systems. Students will explore hardware architecture, communication standards, driver programming techniques, signal processing, and methods for integrating sensors, actuators, and communication modules with microcontrollers or processors. The course focuses on the interaction between hardware, firmware, and peripheral devices, aiming to equip students with the ability to build practical applications such as mini robots, automated control systems, smart IoT devices, and industrial embedded systems.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understanding and Analysis: Students can describe and explain the architecture of embedded systems, the operating principles of peripheral devices, and commonly used communication standards in control systems.

Hardware Design and Interfacing: Students can design and implement connection circuits between microcontrollers and peripheral devices (sensors, actuators, communication modules), ensuring correct voltage levels, signals, and safety requirements.

Communication and Control Programming: Students can write and implement firmware/drivers to communicate with peripheral devices (UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, PWM, etc.) and control actuators in real-world conditions.

System Integration and Problem Solving: Students can integrate multiple peripherals into a complete system, detect, diagnose, and resolve issues related to communication, synchronization, and performance.
Teamwork & Technical Presentation: Students can work effectively in teams and deliver technical reports on the design, interfacing, and control of peripheral devices in labs or project settings.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why are clear design goals important in selecting techniques for embedded system development, and how do these goals influence system performance?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare general-purpose microprocessors, microcontrollers, and DSPs in terms of architecture and application suitability?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why is understanding the difference between analog and digital signals important when designing computer‑controlled systems?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is systematic circuit analysis necessary when designing hardware for embedded applications, and how does it prevent design failures?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare linear passive devices with nonlinear active devices in terms of their roles and impact on circuit functionality?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why are structured design methodologies and modern CAD/EDA tools crucial for developing reliable embedded hardware systems?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is RS‑232 still relevant in certain industrial and legacy systems despite being slower and older than modern digital communication standards?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare I2C and CAN in terms of communication reliability, architecture, and typical application environments.?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why is USB considered more flexible and powerful than traditional serial interfaces, and how do its host-device architecture and plug‑and‑play capabilities improve user experience?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare WiFi and Zigbee in terms of network topology, power consumption, and suitability for IoT deployments?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare Bluetooth Classic and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) with respect to power efficiency, latency, and practical use cases?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why has LoRaWAN become a leading choice for long‑range IoT applications, and how does its low‑power wide‑area mechanism differ from short‑range wireless protocols?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare the key characteristics of digital logic specifications such as logic levels, noise margins, and timing requirements, explaining how each impacts system reliability?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why is CMOS technology widely used in digital logic circuits, and how does its low-power operation compare with other logic families?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why are high‑impedance (Hi‑Z) and open‑drain outputs important in digital systems, and how do they differ in terms of electrical behavior?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why are registers essential components in digital system design, and how do they influence data flow and timing control within a CPU?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why do CPUs require specific interface structures (such as buses and tri‑state lines), and how do these structures support coordinated data transfer?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare the role of auxiliary devices and circuits (such as buffers, drivers, and encoders) in supporting digital logic systems, using a shaft encoder as an example?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why are amplifiers essential in electronic systems, and how do they fundamentally differ from passive signal-conditioning circuits?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why is it important to use systematic circuit analysis methods when designing amplifiers, and how does this minimize design uncertainty?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare MOSFET small‑signal models and large‑signal models in terms of assumptions, applications, and design accuracy?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why are small‑signal models especially useful for analyzing amplifier behavior at mid‑band frequencies?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare the common-source and common-drain amplifiers in terms of voltage gain, input impedance, and output impedance?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why is the cascode amplifier topology effective at improving gain and bandwidth while reducing the Miller effect?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is driving a low-impedance load challenging for many amplifiers, and how do designers address this limitation?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9.2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the challenges of designing multiplexers in FPGA? How can you optimize their performance and resource utilization?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why do power amplifiers require different design considerations than small-signal amplifiers, especially regarding heat dissipation and efficiency?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ10.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare discrete amplifiers with integrated amplifiers in terms of performance consistency, size, and design flexibility?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ10.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why are operational amplifiers considered versatile building blocks, and how do their ideal characteristics differ from real-world behavior?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ10.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare different types of noise and interference that affect amplifier performance, and explain why high-gain circuits are especially vulnerable?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ11.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare the key filter specifications—such as cutoff frequency, passband ripple, stopband attenuation, and quality factor—and explain how each influences filter performance?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ11.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why does the RLC tank circuit exhibit resonance behavior, and how does this property make it useful in frequency-selective applications?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ11.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare the meaning and importance of a transfer function in time-domain versus frequency-domain analysis of circuits?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare active op-amp filters with passive RC filters in terms of gain capability, impedance control, and implementation complexity?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why is an op-amp bass boost filter effective for audio enhancement, and how does its frequency response differ from standard low-pass or band-pass filters?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why are digital filters increasingly used in modern systems, and how do they differ from analog filters in flexibility, accuracy, and implementation constraints?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ13.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare monostable, astable, and bistable timing circuits in terms of operating principles and typical applications?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ13.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare an arbitrary waveform generator (AWG) with standard function generators in terms of waveform flexibility, memory requirements, and application scenarios?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ13.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why do signal detectors play a critical role in communication and audio systems, and how do envelope detectors differ from level detectors?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ14.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is the Nyquist rate fundamental in sampling theory, and how does violating the Nyquist criterion lead to aliasing?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ14.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why does increasing resolution in digital/analog conversion improve output quality, and what practical limitations prevent infinite resolution?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ14.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why is the R‑2R DAC architecture widely used in integrated circuits, and how does its performance compare to other DAC topologies with respect to scaling and precision?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ15.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare key power supply specifications such as voltage regulation, load regulation, efficiency, ripple, and transient response and explain their impact on system behavior?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ15.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why are AC‑to‑DC power supplies essential for most electronic devices, and how do linear and switch‑mode AC‑DC converters differ in design and performance?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ15.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare buck, boost, and buck‑boost converters in terms of circuit structure, voltage conversion capability, and typical application scenarios?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ16.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why must interface designers thoroughly understand the use case of an embedded system before beginning hardware or software design?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ16.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare simple embedded systems (e.g., appliances) with complex embedded systems (e.g., automotive ECUs) in terms of interface requirements?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ16.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare functional requirements and non‑functional requirements in interface design, explaining how each affects the final system?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ17.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare centralized and distributed interface architectures in terms of complexity, flexibility, and reliability?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ17.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why is selecting the appropriate hardware/software platform essential for successful interface design, and what trade‑offs must designers consider?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ17.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why do construction technologies (such as PCB design, wiring methods, and enclosure choices) significantly impact interface reliability and manufacturability?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ18.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare prototyping methods such as breadboards, perfboards, and custom PCBs in terms of durability, noise sensitivity, and production readiness?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ18.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why are closed‑loop control systems essential in many embedded applications, and how do they differ from open‑loop systems in stability and accuracy?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ18.3
constructive_questions.Details: Compare proportional, integral, and derivative control strategies, explaining how each influences system responsiveness?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ19.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is defining the hardware/software boundary a major design decision, and how do designers determine which functions belong in hardware or software?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ19.2
constructive_questions.Details: Compare hardware‑centric and software‑centric interface solutions in terms of flexibility, performance, and cost?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ19.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why must designers carefully manage the analog/digital boundary, and how do noise and quantization influence system accuracy?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ20.1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare analog signal-processing approaches with digital signal-processing approaches in terms of flexibility and component requirements?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ20.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why are structured interface design methodologies crucial for avoiding errors, and how do iterative and waterfall models differ in embedded projects?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ20.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why must motor controllers balance electrical, thermal, and mechanical considerations simultaneously, and how does this complicate interface design?
